Kyle.fact: Kyle arrives at the parts shop and positions himself at the counter with his hand near his katana's guard.
Sable offers Kyle a cold-chain pharmaceutical courier job from Bucktown to eastern district 4 with an eleven-hour window at a rate of thirty-one thousand.
Kyle identifies the route as a Lotus Syndicate route, and Sable confirms the original courier was flagged as compromised.
Kyle types a question about why the courier was flagged, holds it for two seconds, then deletes it character by character and accepts the job.
Sable warns Kyle that the eleven-hour window is firm, replacing what Kyle perceives was a different, unspoken message.
Kyle internally acknowledges that his NeoCortex has logged Sable's cadence shift forty-seven times across four years, indicating she regularly replaces what she intends to say.
Kyle leaves the parts shop and walks out into the rain.
Kyle arrives at the warehouse seven minutes before the contracted hour and spends four minutes surveilling the entrance before entering.
Kyle inspects the crate's tamper-evident seals and cold-chain diagnostic strip, confirming the cargo is intact and within temperature parameters.
Kyle authenticates the chain-of-custody form by pressing his temple to the terminal, causing his NeoCortex to write his identity into the warehouse ledger.

The narration reveals that Kyle's authentication has written his identity into a ledger readable by anyone who knows what a NeoCortex signature looks like in a Vásquez Holdings record — unknown to Kyle.
Kyle loads the crate onto a freelancer cart and walks it toward the bay door to leave the warehouse.
Kyle arrives at the receiving dock eight minutes ahead of schedule and rolls the cart to the inspection counter.
The clerk scans and identifies Consignment 0431-A using her Pellucid Systems eye augmentations in a four-second optimized sequence.
The clerk countersigns the chain-of-custody terminal without reading the form and releases the crate to the automated warehouse track.
Kyle presses his temple to the reader and receives delivery confirmation on his NeoCortex feed.
Kyle notices the 'PENDING REGULATORY CLEAR' flag on his delivery confirmation, signaling an unexpected hold on his payment.
The clerk explains that a Tier 4 customs review has placed a routine twelve-hour hold on the pharmaceutical consignment due to a SKU reclassification from Class B to Class A.
Kyle chooses not to ask whether the regulatory hold will delay his fee, suppressing the question.
Kyle's body overrides his conscious intent and he turns left toward Mrs. Chen's stall in response to a persistent NeoCortex metabolism flag.
Kyle arrives at Mrs. Chen's stall and sits down without exchanging words.
Mrs. Chen sets a bowl of pork bone broth and chili oil in front of Kyle without being asked or told his order.
Mrs. Chen refills Kyle's bowl unprompted partway through his meal.
Kyle looks at his hands around the bowl and thinks about nothing in particular for the first time in eleven hours.
Kyle pays and leaves the stall without saying goodbye, in keeping with the unspoken terms of the arrangement.
Kyle walks the four blocks and arrives at The Pivot, climbing the stairs to 2F.
The NeoCortex detects four coordinated pressure signatures ascending the stairwell at 04:21:07, identifying them as armed, trained individuals.
Four armed individuals breach Kyle's door using a shock-baton and electromag pulse, plunging the corridor into darkness.
Kyle is struck twice with a shock-baton — first at the chrome bracket in his jaw, then a second blow that puts him on the floor.
The assailants hood Kyle and carry him down twenty-two stairs out of the building.
Kyle is brought to the south-arm chamber of the Cruciform Depot and bound to a steel chair with his wrists behind his back.
Kyle's hood is removed and he observes a juvenile crocodile sleeping on a heat rock in the chamber.
